final: WITH sex_avg AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / l.GPT) AS sa FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), fo AS (SELECT AVG(sa) AS v FROM sex_avg WHERE sa IS NOT NULL), k1 AS (SELECT s.sex, s.sa, s.sa - fo.v AS d1 FROM sex_avg s, fo WHERE fo.v IS NOT NULL AND s.sa IS NOT NULL AND s.sa > fo.v), so AS (SELECT AVG(sa) AS v FROM k1 WHERE sa IS NOT NULL), k2 AS (SELECT k1.sex, k1.sa, k1.d1, k1.sa - so.v AS d2 FROM k1, so WHERE so.v IS NOT NULL AND k1.sa IS NOT NULL AND k1.sa > so.v) SELECT AVG(sa) AS avg_sex_avg, AVG(d1) AS avg_diff_first, AVG(d2) AS avg_diff_second FROM k2
